reason: Classified as an automation-focused DSH plugin because it automatically observes agent tool activity and injects a reminder context to encourage external research when repetitive local trial-and-error becomes costly. The readme states it is triggered by configurable debt thresholds, supports reset on recognized research tools, and integrates through the DeepSeek Harness post-tool lifecycle. It is user-facing as a workflow nudge, not as an external search or editing tool.

summaries.zh: dsh-research-nudge 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，基于代理的本地工具调用与失败情况自动计算研究债务，并在达到阈值时提醒模型考虑查阅文档或联网搜索以减少反复试错。
summaries.en: dsh-research-nudge is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that tracks agent tool usage and failures and automatically issues advisory reminders to consider docs or web research when configured research-debt thresholds are reached.

capabilities: Monitors DeepSeek Harness tool execution and results through the post-execute lifecycle
Tracks a per-agent score from tool call, mutation, failure, and repeated-failure signals
Injects an advisory user-visible context message when debt/call-count/time thresholds are reached
Resets state when configured research-tool names are used and supports configurable policy values

reasons.code: The plugin hooks into the DSH tools/post-execute waterfall and adds a model-visible context via createUserMessage/ PostToolDecision.additionalContexts.
The policy describes weighted debt signals (ordinary tools, mutation, execution, failure, repeated failure) and threshold/cooldown configuration that drives reminder eligibility.
Runtime behavior is positioned as advisory-only (no blocking or result override), with stated no telemetry/network/API-key usage and no persisted storage of tool arguments.
The plugin is packaged as a DeepSeek Harness bundle via package metadata, indicating integration as framework middleware rather than a standalone utility.
